completion_data.completion_summary: Created /literature command with skill (5 sub-modes: status, scan, convert, validate, index) and agent documentation, registered in core manifest, merge-sources, and CLAUDE.md.

memory_candidates.content: The /literature command follows the direct-execution pattern (Pattern B) like /distill and /fix-it: command.md parses args and delegates to skill-literature via the Skill tool; skill-literature runs inline with AskUserQuestion — no agent subagent is spawned. pdftotext (poppler, available) is the primary conversion tool; djvutxt (djvulibre) is not installed and requires graceful degradation. Token counting: chars/4 + 20 (same as memory-harvest.sh). Chunking: 10 pages per chunk = ~4000 tokens.
